description: Formal symbolic proof that the two derivations of the Jones-Markov weights y_λ(q) at H_3(q) are equivalent as rational functions in q. Path A: linear-system solve on the Markov-axiom ladder basis. Path B: Wenzl Schur principal specialization with parameter Q^r fixed by z_W = q·z, Q = q². sympy's sp.simplify reduces y_A − y_B to 0 exactly for every λ ∈ {(3), (2,1), (1,1,1)}. Equivalence of tr_M via Wedderburn vs markov_peel recursive ascent then follows from uniqueness of the Markov-axiom-satisfying linear functional on H_n.
